text:
Arjun: Heads up — BlackBox (our Q3 reserved supplier) just pushed shipment ETAs 6-8 weeks and can only commit ~60% of the GPUs they reserved for us. Need a multi-supplier fallback plan ASAP.

Kevin: Rough numbers? how many units impacted?

Maria: BlackBox had 1,200 GPUs reserved for Q3. They can deliver ~720 within month 2, remaining maybe month 4. :confused:

Sasha: If we swap part volume to ByteEdge we need to validate image/driver stack. Estimate ~2 weeks dev + 3 days validation for basic model checks.

Dan: Marketplace note — swapping SKUs mid-quarter will change billing lines and reserved-capacity tags. We'll need a short freeze window to update manifests and notify customers.

Priya: Contract question — do we have penalties or SLAs for partial deliveries? Need PO + vendor contract to assess amendment. cc legal team.

Arjun: My proposal: 1) split the shortfall across ByteEdge + NebulaCloud, 2) open an emergency PO to ByteEdge for ~300 GPUs (3 week delivery), 3) publish a market-facing note for customers about potential capacity jitter, 4) set a credit plan for impacted commitments.

Kevin: I'll ping ByteEdge now and confirm lead times + customs slots.

Maria: I'll draft partner-facing emails and loop partner success. Also recommend we apply temporary reservation throttles in Console to protect enterprise customers.

Sasha: For NebulaCloud we can roll a driver container fast; need a CI job to run inference smoke at 512 context. I can allocate 2 infra engineers — ETA 10 business days.

Priya: Send PO + vendor emails to me once Kevin has them. If we impose throttles we need to verify notice periods in customer T&Cs.

Arjun: Action items + owners: Kevin (vendor confirm), Maria (partner comms + PR), Sasha (integration plan + smoke tests), Priya (contract checks). Target: vendor confirmations by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Created emergency PO PO-8347 (draft) for ByteEdge. Link: https://procurement.redwood/po/PO-8347 :white_check_mark:

Kevin: ByteEdge replied — they can allocate 320 units, ETA 21 days. Customs slot needs confirmation; they requested net-30 payment terms.

Dan: I'll lock a 48h window to update marketplace manifests and suspend auto price recalcs while we patch metadata.

Arjun: Good. If ByteEdge falls through fallback to NebulaCloud. Maria, please prep a joint partner statement and a customer-facing FAQ. Consider offering partial credits to top 5 committed customers.

Maria: On it — drafting now, will post to #customer-notifications and share the draft here for review. :pencil2:

Sasha: Small ask — can we prioritize smoke tests for our top models (gpt-emu and code-runner) on the ByteEdge config? I'll queue them and share results.

Priya: Also confirm export control and APAC compliance paperwork for NebulaCloud — they operate nodes in that region.

Arjun: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene 09:00 tomorrow for a vendor-confirmation check-in. :alarm_clock:

Kevin: noted, pinging now.

Maria: draft will be ready by 16:00 PT.

Sasha: queued tests, will post logs in this thread when done.

ops-bot: PO-8347 status updated -> vendor-acknowledged.

Arjun: Great progress — please upload any vendor emails/attachments to the thread and tag me.

Priya: Received PO + vendor emails, starting review.

Dan: I'll publish a tentative marketplace maintenance window once we confirm final SKUs.

Arjun: Closing for tonight — thanks. We should keep this thread as the single source for comms and attach all artifacts.
